requirements.title: MAXVAL argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an integer, real, or character array; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range 1 through the rank of ARRAY; optional MASK shall be logical and conformable with ARRAY.

pending.MAXVAL-ARRAY-integer-real-or-character-a: Positive source controls call MAXVAL with integer, exact real, and character arrays; source-control mutations use scalar, logical-array, and complex-array ARRAY actuals and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAXVAL-DIM-integer-scalar-in-range: Positive source controls use DIM=1 and DIM=2 for a rank-two array; source-control mutations use DIM=0, DIM=3, and a noninteger DIM and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAXVAL-MASK-logical-conformable: Positive source controls use absent MASK, conformable logical MASK arrays, and mixed true/false masks; source-control mutations use nonlogical or nonconformable MASK values and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MAXVAL result type, parameters, rank, and shape
requirements.definition: MAXVAL returns the same type and type parameters as ARRAY; absent DIM gives a scalar result, and present DIM gives rank n-1 with the DIM extent removed.

pending.MAXVAL-result-same-type-and-parameters: Evaluate integer, exact real, and character MAXVAL calls into distinct sentinels; assert KIND and character LEN follow ARRAY, and mutate ARRAY kind or character length so the checks fail.
pending.MAXVAL-no-DIM-scalar: Call MAXVAL on a rank-two integer array, assign to a scalar initialized away from the expected value, assert the maximum, and mutate to a DIM call so scalar shape handling fails.
pending.MAXVAL-DIM-rank-and-shape: Use a [2,3,4] integer array and DIM=2, assert SHAPE(MAXVAL(A,DIM=2))==[2,4], and mutate DIM to 1 so shape or values fail.

requirements.title: MAXVAL whole-array result and zero-size defaults
requirements.definition: MAXVAL of a nonzero-size ARRAY has the maximum element value; zero-size integer or real ARRAY returns the negative number of the largest supported magnitude, and zero-size character ARRAY returns LEN(ARRAY) characters each equal to CHAR(0,KIND(ARRAY)).

pending.MAXVAL-nonzero-integer-maximum: Use an integer array with negative, zero, and positive elements in non-sorted order; assert MAXVAL equals the positive maximum and mutate the maximum element smaller so the check fails.
pending.MAXVAL-nonzero-exact-real-maximum: Use exactly representable real elements -9.0, 7.0, and 2.0; assert MAXVAL equals 7.0 exactly and mutate the largest value to 6.0 so the check fails.
pending.MAXVAL-zero-size-integer-negative-larges: Use a zero-size integer array and a nonzero companion; assert MAXVAL(zero)==-HUGE(0) and companion MAXVAL differs, then mutate the zero extent to one so the default check fails.
pending.MAXVAL-zero-size-real-negative-largest: Use a zero-size real array and a nonzero companion; assert MAXVAL(zero)==-HUGE(0.0) exactly and companion MAXVAL differs, then mutate the zero extent to one so the default check fails.
pending.MAXVAL-zero-size-character-CHAR-zero: Use a zero-size character array of length three and a nonzero companion; assert LEN(result)==3 and every character equals CHAR(0,KIND(array)), then mutate expected CHAR(0) to a blank so the check fails.

requirements.title: MAXVAL MASK and DIM results follow PACK and slice reductions
requirements.definition: MAXVAL with MASK has the value of MAXVAL(PACK(ARRAY,MASK)); with DIM, rank-one ARRAY gives the no-DIM result and higher-rank ARRAY reduces each DIM slice with the corresponding MASK slice.

pending.MAXVAL-MASK-equals-PACK-reduction: Use an integer array whose unmasked maximum is excluded by a mixed mask; assert MAXVAL(A,MASK) equals the maximum of PACK(A,MASK) and mutate MASK to all true so the check fails.
pending.MAXVAL-DIM-rank-one-equals-no-DIM: Use rank-one integer array [5,-9,3], assert MAXVAL(A,DIM=1)==MAXVAL(A)==5, and mutate the expected scalar to a rank-one shape control so the check fails.
pending.MAXVAL-DIM-higher-rank-slice-results: Use a 2x3 integer array with distinct column and row maxima, assert MAXVAL(A,DIM=1)==[2,7,6] and MAXVAL(A,DIM=2)==[5,7], and mutate DIM to the other dimension so shape or values fail.
pending.MAXVAL-DIM-forwards-MASK: Use a 2x3 integer array and a conformable mask excluding a slice maximum; assert per-slice MAXVAL with DIM reflects the mask slice, and mutate one mask element to true so the slice value fails.
